action.sql: SELECT g.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-04' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS apr_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-05' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS may_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-05' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-04' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END) AS change FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6000 AND 6999 AND g.period IN ('2026-04', '2026-05') GROUP BY g.account_id ORDER BY change DESC LIMIT 1
